sources.title: README.md · Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.1-3B at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction Nanbeige4.1-3B is built upon Nanbeige4-3B-Base and represents an enhanced iteration of our previous reasoning model, Nanbeige4-3B-Thinking-2511, achieved through further post-training optimization with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL).

sources.snippet: How to deploy Nanbeige4.1-3B on Lambda: 3B dense code model for single GPU. Get SGLang/vLLM setup, VRAM requirements, and throughput benchmarks.

sources.title: Nanbeige4.1-3B: A Small General Model that Reasons, Aligns, and Acts
sources.snippet: Our model, Nanbeige4.1-3B, demonstrates a remarkable leap in performance compared to its baseline Nanbeige4-3B-2511 and significantly outperforms other small foundation models with tools across all benchmarks.
